description: ODC: the REFUSAL of the rename verb on a static entity record when the new name already belongs to another record. The ODC IStaticEntityRecord does not publish Name: the record name is the property Identifier (the setter calls SetName), and that is what rename writes (since 2026-10-03; before it refused with "IStaticEntityRecord 'UnderReview' has no Name"). As in set Identifier, the kernel checks AbstractObject.NameClash before writing, because SetName would add a suffix SILENTLY (Received -> Received2). The positive path is in tests/jobs-odc/rename-name-property.json; the same via set Identifier in tests/jobs-odc/static-entity-lifecycle.json and set-identifier-clash.json.
expectError: rename: 'Received' clashes with an existing name in that scope

ops._why: the name that already exists in the scope: Received.

ops.name: Received
ops._why: refused: rename writes Identifier, and Received already belongs to another record of the WfClaimStage.
